SlashCommand(/speckit.specify Create a Mini Games feature for the Smartico platform that allows users to play interactive games and win prizes. The feature should integrate into the existing Smartico.Missions backend infrastructure using Clean Architecture + CQRS pattern.

## Feature Requirements:

**US1: View Available Mini Games**
- As a user, I want to see a list of all available mini games so I can choose which game to play
- Display game name, description, thumbnail, and game type
- Show buy-in cost (points/gems/diamonds or free)
- Display next available spin time if limited
- Show jackpot amount if enabled
- Filter by game type (Spin the Wheel, Gift Box, Scratch Card, MatchX)

**US2: Play Mini Game**
- As a user, I want to play a mini game and win prizes
- Validate user has sufficient points/gems/diamonds for buy-in
- Check spin attempt limits and cooldowns
- Execute game play and determine prize
- Award prize immediately (points, spins, bonus, etc.)
- Show win animation and acknowledgment message

**US3: View Prize History**
- As a user, I want to see my prize history so I can track my wins
- Display list of all prizes won
- Show prize type, value, and timestamp
- Filter by date range and prize type

**US4: Real-time Updates**
- Broadcast mini game play events via SignalR
- Update jackpot amounts in real-time
- Notify users when new games become available
- Show live prize pool depletion

**US5: Game Stats and Leaderboards**
- Display total games played
- Show total prizes won
- Leaderboard for most wins/highest jackpot

## Technical Context:

**Existing Infrastructure:**
- Backend: .NET 9 / ASP.NET Core 9 with Clean Architecture
- Domain Layer: Entities and interfaces
- Application Layer: MediatR CQRS (queries + commands with FluentValidation)
- Infrastructure Layer: Caching (30s TTL), SignalR broadcaster, Polly resilience
- API Layer: Controllers, SignalR hub (/hubs/progress)
- Frontend: React 19 + TypeScript

**Smartico API Reference:**
- TMiniGameTemplate: Game configuration with prizes, buy-in costs, limits
- TMiniGamePrize: Prize details (type, value, pool, acknowledgment)
- TMiniGamePlayResult: Play outcome with prize_id and error codes
- MiniGamePrizeTypeName: Prize types (no-prize, points, bonus, manual, spin, jackpot, change-level, mission, raffle-ticket, gems-and-diamonds)

**Integration Pattern:**
- Follow same pattern as Missions and Bonuses (already implemented)
- Reuse IProgressBroadcaster for real-time events
- Use same caching, logging, and API client patterns
- MediatR for CQRS (GetMiniGamesQuery, PlayMiniGameCommand)
- FluentValidation for command validation

**Prize Types to Support:**
1. NO_PRIZE - No reward
2. POINTS - Gamification points
3. BONUS - Bonus template trigger
4. MANUAL - Manual intervention required
5. SPIN - Additional spin attempts
6. JACKPOT - Jackpot prize pool
7. CHANGE_LEVEL - Level progression
8. MISSION - Mission unlock
9. RAFFLE_TICKET - Raffle entry
10. GEMS_AND_DIAMONDS - Virtual currency
11. UNKNOWN - Fallback

**Buy-in Types:**
- Free (no cost)
- Points (deduct from points balance)
- Gems (deduct from gems balance)
- Diamonds (deduct from diamonds balance)
- Spin attempts (consume spin counter)

**Game Limits:**
- Max attempts per period
- Cooldown between plays
- Prize pool depletion
- Time-based availability (activeFromDate/activeTillDate)

## Constraints:

- Integrate into existing Smartico.Missions.* projects (do NOT create separate projects)
- Reuse existing SignalR hub (/hubs/progress) with new events
- Use same patterns as Bonuses implementation (CQRS, caching, validation)
- Support demo data for MVP testing
- Build must succeed with 0 warnings/errors)
SlashCommand(/speckit.implement MVP tasks to ensure working demo.)
